title: Boundary wall maximum length, R10-R17.5 (9 m)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.8.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, maximum boundary wall length: R10 - R17.5 9m.

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.4#length-r10-r17.5. Table 3.4c (p34) values unchanged from Chapter 3; the clause text now cites C3.8.1 for overshadowing. 9 m. Posts on the boundary of 450 mm or less are excluded from boundary wall length (Table 3.4b note).
